retain: Use existing HARNESS_HOME/backup/<id>/modified/ stash for the old profile object plus type/hash manifest,outside profile/. No move or fabricated installed.json reference.
visibility: profile/archive/old CAN be default-visible: nonhidden top-level directories become roots; SKIP_DIRS filters children,not the selected archive root. Backup is not a built-in root; explicit roots/links could expose it.
prune: Referenced backups and backups containing modified/ are excluded. Other unreferenced nonsymlink directories retain newest3 by name; older ones can be silently deleted. Unreadable installed.json suppresses backup pruning only temporarily.
limits: Protection is storage.prune-specific,not permanent retention or access control. A preserved symlink does not freeze target bytes. Actual roots/object/stores uninspected. No tests/prune/runtime/config/source changes; root verifies before switching.
preparation: Two oversized drafts rejected before writes; reduced prose.
